questions.question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

My house / is more / spacious than / my sister.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '4' i.e. my sister .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence compares the house of the speaker with "my sister," which is incorrect. The comparison should be made between similar entities, i.e., "my house" and "my sister's house."
 
• The grammatical error lies in the fourth segment, "my sister," as it does not provide a proper comparison for "my house."
 
• To correct the sentence, the possessive form should be used to compare the two houses. Instead of "my sister," it should be "my sister's house."

Correct sentence: *My house is more spacious than my sister's house*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Comparison Rules:**

 
 
• When comparing two entities, ensure that they are of the same type (e.g., house vs. house, car vs. car).
 
• Use the possessive form (e.g., "my sister's house") if the comparison involves ownership.
 
 
 
• **Common Errors in Comparison:**
 
 
• Avoid vague or incomplete comparisons like "my sister" instead of "my sister's house."
 
• Ensure the adjective used (e.g., "spacious") is appropriate for both entities being compared.

questions.question:
**The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them contains an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options.**

He was / late / for school / and punished.
questions.solution:
The erroneous part is** 'and punished'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• ​In a** compound sentence**, both the** auxiliary verbs** and **main verbs** should be mentioned **separately **if they differ in number, form or voice.
 
• For example:
 
 
• The criminal surrendered before the Judge and sent to prison. (incorrect)
 
• The criminal surrendered before the Judge and **was** sent to prison. (correct)
 
 
 
• Similarly, in this context, the auxiliary verb and the main verb should be mentioned separately. Hence, 'was' must be placed before 'punished'.

Therefore, the correct answer is: *He was late for school and **was** punished.*

questions.question:
**Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.**

A. However, when areas in Leh began to experience water shortages, life didn’t grind to a halt.

B. Ladakh is a cold desert with a low average annual rainfall.

C. Thus, glaciers have been the main source of water for the people.

D. This was because Chewang Norphel, a retired civil engineer came up with the idea of artificial glaciers.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**BCAD**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given question is an example of a Para Jumble.
 
• We know that the first statement of a para jumbled question is usually an independent general statement, a noun, a universal fact, starting of an incident, or it starts with 'most' or 'once'.
 
 
• **Sentence B** will be the first sentence because it is an introductory sentence and talks about the cold desert of '**Ladakh**'.
 
• **Sentence C** will be the next sentence because the previous sentence talks about the cold desert and **Sentence C** further tells us what is the source of water for the people in Ladakh.
 
• **Sentence A** will be the next sentence because it is connected with the previous sentence.
 
• Lastly, **Sentence D **will be used.
 
• Thus, the correct sequence is:
 
 
• **B**: Ladakh is a cold desert with a low average annual rainfall.
 
• **C**: Thus, glaciers have been the main source of water for the people.
 
• **A**: However, when areas in Leh began to experience water shortages, life didn’t grind to a halt.
 
• **D**: This was because Chewang Norphel, a retired civil engineer came up with the idea of artificial glaciers.

 
 
 
 
 

**Correct Sequence:__*** Ladakh is a cold desert with a low average annual rainfall. Thus, glaciers have been the main source of water for the people. However, when areas in Leh began to experience water shortages, life didn’t grind to a halt. This was because Chewang Norphel, a retired civil engineer came up with the idea of artificial glaciers.*

questions.question:

questions.solution:

questions.question:

Mother said, “Abhinav slipped while trying to board a bus.”

options.text: Mother told that Abhinav slipped while trying to board a bus.
Mother says that Abhinav slipped while trying to board a bus.

• In the given sentence the reporting verb has no object. Hence, 'said' will not be changed. 
 
• Comma and inverted commas will be removed.

questions.question:

 ​
